title: Can AI Design a Better nnU-Net? A Hypothesis-Driven Architecture Discovery Loop from Failures to Design Rules
abstract: arXiv:2611.32384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural architecture search and LLM-driven evolution often reduce evaluation to a scalar fitness score, discarding failures that could explain why designs succeed or fail. We present a hypothesis-driven architecture discovery loop in which LLM agents diagnose structured error patterns, formulate falsifiable hypotheses, test counterfactual controls under a frozen nnU-Net pipeline, and distill validated mechanisms into executable trigger-to-action rules. Across eight search waves, the loop identifies two principles for 3D medical image segmentation. First, reallocating computation from high-resolution decoders to the mid-encoder preserves thin-anatomy boundaries while reducing cost. Second, support-confined region contrast addresses errors between nested anatomical compartments, with anatomy-dependent triggers selecting when the rule applies. These principles produce LeanNeXt (0.78 MACs and 0.92 training-step time relative to nnU-Net; +1.63

translated_title: AI能设计出更好的nnU-Net吗？一种从失败到设计规则的假设驱动架构发现循环
translated_abstract: 神经架构搜索和LLM驱动的进化方法通常将评估简化为一个标量适应度分数，从而丢弃了那些本可以解释设计为何成功或失败的失败案例。我们提出了一种假设驱动的架构发现循环，其中LLM智能体诊断结构化的错误模式、提出可证伪的假设、在冻结的nnU-Net流水线下测试反事实对照实验，并将经过验证的机制提炼为可执行的“触发-行动”规则。在八轮搜索过程中，该循环为3D医学图像分割识别出了两条设计原则：第一，将计算资源从高分辨率解码器重新分配到中部编码器，可以在降低成本的同时保留细薄解剖结构的边界；第二，支撑受限的区域对比能够解决嵌套解剖腔室之间的错误，并通过依赖解剖结构的触发器来决定该规则何时适用。这些原则催生了LeanNeXt（相对于nnU-Net，其计算量为0.78倍MACs、训练步时间为0.92倍；性能提升+1.63 Dice）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种假设驱动的架构发现循环，让LLM智能体从失败案例中诊断错误模式、提出可证伪假设并验证机制，最终提炼出两条设计规则，构建出比nnU-Net计算量更低、分割精度更高的3D医学图像分割网络LeanNeXt。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hypothesis-driven architecture discovery loop in which LLM agents diagnose failure patterns, test falsifiable hypotheses, and distill validated mechanisms into executable design rules, yielding LeanNeXt—a 3D medical image segmentation network that outperforms nnU-Net with less computation.
